title: 第21章 浅处无妨有卧龙第22章 嘿本事西类
content_zh:
真是晦气，之前已手下留情，这青年依然得寸进尺，不知进退，那就别怪他江凡不客气，闪身两步向前，没有动用任何修为，右腿猛地一抬，以同样姿势踢向青年，顺便送个小福利。
砰，孟文旻感觉胸部犹如撞到百迈疾速行驶汽车般，腹部一阵翻江倒海，嘴中再次喷出一口鲜血，双脚离地，向着后方飞去，小白脸怎么可能有如此大的爆发力？
孟德庭快步上前接住被踹飞的文旻，巨大力道逼得连退三步，内力一阵紊乱，嘴角沁出一丝血迹，没有借力，只是随意一脚，力道居然恐怖如斯！
“文旻狂傲不羁，多谢小友手下留情。”
“无妨，不用谢。”
放下文旻，还好这位年轻人手下留情，否则全力一击，不死也得半残，文旻经此教训和打击，心性会收敛许多，也会成长和成熟不少，孟德庭拱手询问道：“不知小友师出何门？”
师出何门？江凡内心一阵诧异，地球上也有修炼的宗门？可能是少林、武当、峨眉、天师等门派，无奈摇了摇头：“在下无门无派，一介散修。”
孟德庭苦笑摇头，华夏卧虎藏龙，可也没有如此年轻厉害的散修，萍水相逢，小兄弟只是不想暴露师门而已，或是世家子弟，可金陵也没有如此优秀世家子弟，随即热忱问道：“不知小友可有时间？”
江凡淡然扫了眼憋屈青年，在此浪费时间，不就是想找个问路人，了解下华夏修炼者情况，做了个请的手势，意味深长说道：“你身上的伤有十来年了吧？”
“你怎么知道？”
孟德庭心头骇然，不可置信望向江凡，搜索脑海记忆，自己之前从未见过眼前年轻人，也从未见过武功如此了得年轻人。
武者内伤，不论是中医的望闻问切，还是西医的现代医疗设备，皆查不出来他的伤情，也就一位老友以古医之术查出，可眼前的青年是怎么知道他有暗伤，还准确说出来伤势有十来年？
“我不是说不用谢吗？”
不用谢？孟德庭一头雾水，突然气血一阵翻涌，牵动暗伤，忍不住喷出一口鲜血，鲜血有不少黑丝和斑块，体内暗伤瘀血？随即运转雷霆拳功法，内力运行通畅许多，暗伤也没有之前那么疼痛，不由得再次震惊，年轻人所说的不用谢是帮他逼出体内瘀血？
“爷爷，你怎么样？”
孟文旻愤怒看向江凡，立即再次摆起雷霆拳起手式，即使不敌，哪怕重伤，也要拼死鱼死网破！
“不可！”
孟德庭立即喝住文旻，内心极为震惊，这年轻人只有十七八岁年纪，内力深不可测也就算了，可又如何看出他的暗伤，还轻松帮忙逼出不少瘀血，难不成这年轻人已练出内劲，年纪轻轻的便是内劲强者！
可世上怎么会有如此年轻的内劲强者？孟德庭欲要再次拱手感谢，见江凡示意他伸出手臂，要用中医手段帮忙检查伤情，也不再犹豫，手腕伸向江凡。
江凡缓缓伸出手掌，三根手指搭在老者手腕的经脉处，一股灵力沿着手指进入老者体内，沿着经脉探寻一番，很快找到老者暗伤之处，只是受伤原因有些奇怪。

感受着一股强大、霸道的内力进入体内，孟德庭再次骇然，内力与他体内内力相比，简直是溪流与江河之别，这年轻人是如何年纪轻轻修炼出内劲？
“经脉有七八处受损，导致你运气不舒畅，平时有轻微疼痛感，酷暑之日伴有刺痛感”
，江凡淡然道，冰火不相融，老者的暗伤像是被冰系术法或法器所伤，看来地球上也有修真者，随即继续说道：“雷霆拳过于阳刚，常此修炼下去，恐怕不出三年……”
什么？孟德庭震惊看向眼前少年，少年所言与他老友所言如出一辙，五年前老友也是告诫他修炼功法过于刚硬，同伤势有较大冲突，常此修炼可能不出十年便会暴毙而亡，而眼前少年恐怕推测的时间更为准确……
“爷爷，你？”
孟文旻双眼通红，眼泪潸然而下，从未听爷爷提起过受伤，爷爷的身子骨很是硬朗，可，怎么可能三年内暴毙而亡？
眼前老者的上位者气息颇为浓厚，非富即贵之人，江凡倒是可以借老者之手收集些珍贵中药材，哑然失笑道：“也不是什么大不了的伤势，想要治愈也不是很难，只是要用到一些名贵罕见的中药材。”
“什么？”
孟德庭身体禁不住剧烈颤抖，这少年到底是何方神圣，老友的药方只能延缓疼痛，而眼前少年却有信心治愈十多年的暗伤，仿佛他的暗伤对于少年完全不值得一提！
“所料不差的话，你的暗伤应该来自寒冰类的功法或武器，大约有十三年之久！”
望向风轻云淡的江凡，孟德庭内心再次掀起惊涛骇浪，眼前少年所言一字不差，千禧年他遭遇日本忍者的寒冰武器偷袭，此事只有极少数人知道，而少年仅凭切脉便准确推断出时间和原因！
孟德庭凝视着江凡，想起之前涌入经脉雄厚的内力，年纪轻轻便修炼到内劲武者，什么样的宗门或世家能教导出如此杰出的子弟，拱手敬畏看向江凡，“老夫孟德庭，敢问小友名讳？”
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
孟德庭？脑海搜索一番，可能前身的段位太低，苏村的政界和商界，没听过这个名字，江凡客气说道：“江凡！”
江凡？孟德庭思索一番，貌似金陵没有江姓的世家，不免有些疑惑，年纪轻轻如此出色，应该不可能没什么名气吧。
“江凡？”
孟文旻一阵疑惑，长三角地区有头有脸的江姓家族基本认识，可也没有江凡这号人物，瞬间想起上个月燕京流传的小道消息，真的极有可能是同一人，好奇问道：“你是燕京秦家的江凡？”
“在下姓江，不姓秦，同燕京秦家没什么关系！”
见江凡对秦家满是不屑，眼前的江凡八成是燕京秦家那个弃少，想要打听出来也很容易，孟德庭随即恭敬问道：“江小友，治愈老夫的伤势，不知需要哪些中药材？”
“有纸笔吗？”

接过钢笔和纸巾，江凡洋洋洒洒写了十多种中药材，千年人参必不可少，已经灭绝或濒临灭绝的石桫椤，找不到也无所谓，有可替代药材选择。
倒不着急询问修炼者事宜，也不着急什么时候能集齐药方上的药材，江凡颇为着急几天后英语六级考试，前身埋下的雷，他也只能被动接着。
“时人莫小池中水，浅处无妨有卧龙”
，望着江凡离去的背影，孟德庭长长叹息，又看向自家孙子，内心止不住再次叹息，别人家的孩子……

content_en:
It's really unlucky. Even though he showed mercy before, this young man is still pushing the envelope and doesn't know how to advance or retreat. So don't blame him for being rude. Jiang Fan took two steps forward without using any cultivation skills. He suddenly raised his right leg and kicked the young man in the same posture, giving him a small benefit.
Bang, Meng Wenmin felt as if his chest had been hit by a speeding car. His abdomen was trembling, and a mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth again. His feet left the ground and flew backward. How could the pretty boy have such explosive power?
Meng Deting quickly stepped forward to catch Wen Min who was kicked away. The huge force forced him to take three steps back. His internal energy was in chaos, and a trace of blood appeared at the corner of his mouth. He didn't use any force, just kicked casually, and the force was so terrifying!
"Wen Min is arrogant and unruly. Thank you for showing mercy, little friend."
"It's okay, you're welcome."
Putting Wen Min down, it was a good thing that this young man showed mercy, otherwise he would have been half disabled even if he had hit him with all his strength. After this lesson and blow, Wen Min would become more restrained and grow more mature. Meng Deting raised his hand and asked, "I wonder where my teacher is from?"
Where did the teacher come from? Jiang Fan felt surprised in his heart, there are also practicing sects on earth? It might be a sect such as Shaolin, Wudang, Emei, Tianshi, etc. He shook his head helplessly: "I have no sect, just a casual cultivator."
Meng Deting smiled bitterly and shook his head. There are no such young and powerful casual cultivators in China, and they met by chance. The little brother just doesn't want to expose his master, or is a child of a family, but there are no such outstanding children of aristocratic families in Jinling. Then he asked enthusiastically: "I wonder if I have time, little friend?"
Jiang Fan glanced at the aggrieved young man indifferently, wasting time here, didn't he just want to find someone to inquire about the situation of Chinese cultivators, made a gesture of invitation, and said meaningfully: "You have been injured for more than ten years, right?"
"How do you know?"
Meng Deting was horrified and looked at Jiang Fan in disbelief, searching his memory. He had never seen the young man in front of him before, and he had never seen a young man with such excellent martial arts.
The internal injuries of the warrior could not be detected by traditional Chinese medicine or modern medical equipment of Western medicine. Only an old friend could detect the injuries using ancient medical techniques. But how did the young man in front of him know that he had hidden injuries and accurately tell that the injuries were more than ten years old?
"Didn't I say you're welcome?"
You're welcome? Meng Deting was confused. Suddenly, there was a surge of energy and blood, which affected the hidden wounds. He couldn't help but spurt out a mouthful of blood. There were many black streaks and plaques in the blood. Was there hidden wounds and blood stasis in his body? Then he started to use the Thunder Fist technique, and his internal energy circulated much more smoothly, and the hidden wounds were not as painful as before. He couldn't help but be shocked again. Did the young man say no thanks to help him force out the blood stasis in his body?
"Grandpa, how are you?"
Meng Wenmin looked at Jiang Fan angrily, and immediately raised his thunder fist again. Even if he was defeated, even if he was seriously injured, he would fight to the death!
"No!"
Meng Deting immediately drank Wen Min, and was extremely shocked. This young man was only seventeen or eighteen years old, and his internal strength was unfathomable. But how could he see his hidden wounds, and easily help force out a lot of blood? Could it be that this young man has developed internal strength, and he is a strong internal strength at a young age!
But how could there be such a young and powerful person in the world? Meng Deting was about to express his gratitude again, but when Jiang Fan gestured for him to stretch out his arm and use Chinese medicine methods to help check the injury, he no longer hesitated and extended his wrist to Jiang Fan.
Jiang Fan slowly stretched out his palm, placed three fingers on the meridians of the old man's wrist, and a stream of spiritual power entered the old man's body along his fingers. After searching along the meridians, he quickly found the old man's hidden injury, but the cause of the injury was a bit strange.
Feeling a powerful and domineering internal force entering his body, Meng Deting was shocked again. Compared with the internal force in his body, the difference between the internal force and the internal force in his body was as different as a stream or a river. How did this young man cultivate his internal force at such a young age?
"Seven or eight meridians have been damaged, causing you to have bad luck and usually have slight pain.Pain, with tingling sensation on hot days.”
, Jiang Fan said calmly, ice and fire do not mix. The old man's hidden injuries seemed to be caused by ice spells or magical weapons. It seems that there are cultivators on the earth. He then continued: "Thunder Fist is too masculine. If you continue to practice like this, I'm afraid it will not take more than three years..."
What? Meng Deting looked at the young man in front of him in shock. What the young man said was exactly the same as what his old friend said. Five years ago, his old friend also warned him that practicing the exercises was too rigid and would conflict with his injuries. If Chang practiced this method, he might die suddenly in less than ten years, and the time that the young man in front of him probably guessed was more accurate...
"Grandpa, you? "
Meng Wenmin's eyes were red and tears were streaming down his face. He had never heard his grandfather mention being injured. His grandfather's body was very strong, but how could he die suddenly within three years?
The old man in front of him had a strong air of superiority. He was either rich or noble. Jiang Fan could use the old man's hands to collect some precious Chinese medicinal materials. He smiled and said: "It's not a big injury. It's not difficult to cure it. It just requires the use of some precious and rare Chinese medicinal materials. "
"What? "
Meng Deting's body couldn't help but tremble violently. Who is this young man? The medicine given by his old friend can only delay the pain, but the young man in front of him is confident of curing the hidden wounds that have lasted for more than ten years, as if his hidden wounds are not worth mentioning to the young man!
"If the predictions are correct, your hidden injuries should have come from ice-based techniques or weapons, which lasted for about thirteen years! "
Looking at the calm Jiang Fan, Meng Deting's heart stirred up turmoil again. What the young man in front of him said was true word for word. In the millennium, he was attacked by Japanese ninjas with ice weapons. Only a few people knew about this, but the young man could accurately deduce the time and reason just by feeling his pulse!
Meng Deting stared at Jiang Fan, remembering the strong internal energy that had poured into his meridians before, and how he had become an internal martial artist at a young age. What kind of sect or family could teach such an outstanding disciple? He raised his hands and looked at Jiang Fan in awe, "I, Meng Deting, dare I ask my little friend's name? "
My dear, there is more to come after this chapter. Please click on the next page to continue reading. There will be more exciting chapters later!
Meng Deting? After searching in my mind, I found out that maybe my predecessor's rank was too low, and the political and business circles in Su Village had never heard of this name. Jiang Fan said politely: "Jiang Fan! "
Jiang Fan? Meng Deting thought about it for a while. It seemed that there was no family named Jiang in Jinling, so he couldn't help but feel a little confused. He was so outstanding at such a young age, so he couldn't be famous.
"Jiang Fan? "
Meng Wenmin was puzzled for a while. He basically knew the well-known Jiang family in the Yangtze River Delta, but there was no one named Jiang Fan. He instantly remembered the gossip circulating in Yanjing last month. It was very likely that they were the same person. He asked curiously: "Are you Jiang Fan from the Qin family in Yanjing? "
"My surname is Jiang, not Qin, and I have nothing to do with the Qin family in Yanjing! "
Seeing that Jiang Fan was full of disdain for the Qin family, the Jiang Fan in front of him was probably the abandoned young man of the Qin family in Yanjing, and it was easy to find out. Meng Deting then asked respectfully: "Little friend Jiang, what Chinese medicinal materials are needed to cure my injury? "
"Do you have a pen and paper? "
Taking the pen and paper towel, Jiang Fan eloquently wrote down more than ten kinds of Chinese medicinal materials. Thousand-year-old ginseng is indispensable. The extinct or endangered Cryptophyllum sibiricum can be found. It doesn't matter if you can't find it. There are alternative medicinal materials to choose from.
He was not in a hurry to ask the practitioners about matters, nor was he anxious about when he would be able to collect the medicinal materials for the prescription. Jiang Fan was quite anxious about taking the CET-6 exam in a few days. He could only passively take care of the thunder laid by his predecessor.
"At that time, people should not put water in small ponds. There would be dragons crouching in shallow places."
, looking at Jiang Fan's leaving back, Meng Deting sighed longly, then looked at his grandson, and couldn't help but sigh again in his heart, other people's children...
